entities.name: Princess Helena Sverkersdotter of Sweden
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Helen of Sweden was a Swedish princess and daughter of King Sverker II of Sweden. She was the mother of Queen Catherine of Sweden. She was later Abbess of Vreta Abbey.
